Third-party components shipped with the Zyberon dashboards. Each remains under its own licence; the Zyberon
licence (../../LICENSE) does not apply to them.

  chart.umd.js              Chart.js            MIT licence          https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
  d3.min.js                 D3                  ISC licence          https://github.com/d3/d3
  d3-sankey.min.js          d3-sankey           BSD 3-Clause licence https://github.com/d3/d3-sankey
  topojson-client.min.js    TopoJSON client     ISC licence          https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client
  tabler/                   Tabler, Tabler Icons MIT licence         tabler/LICENSE-tabler-core.txt, tabler/LICENSE-tabler-icons.txt
